in_marathi.name: Marichi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Son of the Sun God
in_marathi.long_meaning: Marichi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Marichi is the name of the demon son of the Sun God, Surya. He is also known as Maricha and Marichi Makhadev. In Hindu mythology, Marichi is described as a powerful asura, a class of demons. He was a great sage, known for his wisdom and bravery. Marichi is said to have played a significant role in the churning of the ocean of milk, where he was rewarded with the horse, the celestial vehicle of Indra, the god of rain.
